control.text:
Package: com.sideplay
Name: SidePlay
Description: Split screen for CarPlay. Run any app on the car screen, one or two side by side.
Depends: firmware (>= 15.0), mobilesubstrate, preferenceloader
Conflicts: com.cortex.carplayenable, com.pavunato.carsurf, com.bmt.dash, com.chou.googlemaps.vietmap
Maintainer: SidePlay
Author: SidePlay
Section: Tweaks
SileoDepiction: https://sideplay.pages.dev/depictions/com.sideplay.json
Icon: https://sideplay.pages.dev/CydiaIcon.png
Architecture: iphoneos-arm64
Version: 1.0.4-1
Installed-Size: 7196

postinst.text:
#!/bin/sh
# Register the SidePlay app with the home screen and CarPlay
for u in /var/jb/usr/bin/uicache /usr/bin/uicache; do
    if [ -x "$u" ]; then
        "$u" -p /var/jb/Applications/SidePlay.app || true
        break
    fi
done
exit 0

prerm.text:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "remove" ] || [ "$1" = "purge" ]; then
    # Tell the SidePlay server this iPhone removed it (anonymous install list, app/main.m); in the background
    if [ -x /var/jb/Applications/SidePlay.app/SidePlay ]; then
        (/var/jb/Applications/SidePlay.app/SidePlay --sp-goodbye >/dev/null 2>&1 &) || true
    fi
    for u in /var/jb/usr/bin/uicache /usr/bin/uicache; do
        if [ -x "$u" ]; then
            "$u" -u /var/jb/Applications/SidePlay.app || true
            break
        fi
    done
fi
exit 0
